arguments.value: Andrew J. Guilford, born in 1950 in Santa Monica, California, is a former United States District Judge for the Central District of California. He was nominated by George W. Bush in 2006, confirmed by the Senate, and served on the court until his retirement in 2020. He earned his A.B. from the University of California, Los Angeles, in 1972 and his J.D. from the UCLA School of Law in 1975, and practiced in private practice in Costa Mesa, California, from 1975 to 2006.
